questions.subtopic: Sum of cube roots: using x=a+b with x^3=a^3+b^3+3ab(a+b) to solve a cubic

en.prompt:
**[I] Q1 — Numbers and expressions.**

For the real numbers $a$ and $b$ satisfying
$$a^3=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt5-2},\qquad b^3=2-\sqrt5,$$
we are to find the value of $a+b$.

When we set $x=a+b$, we have $x^3=(a+b)^3=a^3+b^3+\boxed{A}\,ab(a+b)$. Since $ab=\boxed{BC}$, we know that this $x$ satisfies
$$x^3+\boxed{D}\,x-\boxed{E}=0.$$

The left side of this equation can be factorized as follows:
$$x^3+\boxed{D}\,x-\boxed{E}=\big(x^3-\boxed{F}\big)+\boxed{D}\big(x-\boxed{F}\big)=\big(x-\boxed{F}\big)\big(x^2+x+\boxed{G}\big).$$

Since
$$x^2+x+\boxed{G}=\left(x+\dfrac{\boxed{H}}{\boxed{I}}\right)^2+\dfrac{\boxed{JK}}{\boxed{L}}>0,$$
we obtain $x=a+b=\boxed{M}$.

ja.prompt:
**[Ⅰ] 問1 — 数と式**

実数 $a$，$b$ が
$$a^3=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt5-2},\qquad b^3=2-\sqrt5$$
を満たすとき，$a+b$ の値を求める。

$x=a+b$ とおくと，$x^3=(a+b)^3=a^3+b^3+\boxed{A}\,ab(a+b)$ である。$ab=\boxed{BC}$ であるから，この $x$ は
$$x^3+\boxed{D}\,x-\boxed{E}=0$$
を満たす。

この方程式の左辺は次のように因数分解できる：
$$x^3+\boxed{D}\,x-\boxed{E}=\big(x^3-\boxed{F}\big)+\boxed{D}\big(x-\boxed{F}\big)=\big(x-\boxed{F}\big)\big(x^2+x+\boxed{G}\big)。$$

さらに
$$x^2+x+\boxed{G}=\left(x+\dfrac{\boxed{H}}{\boxed{I}}\right)^2+\dfrac{\boxed{JK}}{\boxed{L}}>0$$
であるから，$x=a+b=\boxed{M}$ を得る。

explanation.en: Rationalizing, $a^3=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt5-2}=\dfrac{\sqrt5+2}{(\sqrt5-2)(\sqrt5+2)}=\sqrt5+2$. Hence $a^3+b^3=(\sqrt5+2)+(2-\sqrt5)=4$ and $a^3b^3=(2+\sqrt5)(2-\sqrt5)=4-5=-1$, so the real value is $ab=-1$. From $x=a+b$, $x^3=a^3+b^3+3ab(a+b)=4-3x$, i.e. $x^3+3x-4=0$. Since $x^3-1=(x-1)(x^2+x+1)$ and $3(x-1)$ share the factor $(x-1)$: $x^3+3x-4=(x^3-1)+3(x-1)=(x-1)(x^2+x+4)$. The quadratic $x^2+x+4=(x+\tfrac12)^2+\tfrac{15}{4}>0$ has no real root, so $x-1=0$, giving $a+b=1$.
explanation.ja: 分母を有理化すると $a^3=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt5-2}=\sqrt5+2$。よって $a^3+b^3=4$，$a^3b^3=(2+\sqrt5)(2-\sqrt5)=-1$ なので実数では $ab=-1$。$x=a+b$ より $x^3=a^3+b^3+3ab(a+b)=4-3x$，すなわち $x^3+3x-4=0$。$(x^3-1)+3(x-1)=(x-1)(x^2+x+4)$ と因数分解でき，$x^2+x+4=(x+\tfrac12)^2+\tfrac{15}{4}>0$ は実数解をもたないので $x-1=0$，つまり $a+b=1$。

questions.subtopic: Number of intersections of a parabola and a line via the discriminant; maximizing the minimum gap

en.prompt:
**[I] Q2 — Quadratic functions.** *(For $\boxed{N},\boxed{O},\boxed{P}$ choose which of $⓪$–$②$ gives the correct condition.)*

Consider the two functions $y=x^2+ax+a$ and $y=x+1$.

(1) The number of points at which the graphs of the two functions meet depends on the relationship of $a$ with the numbers $\boxed{Q}$ and $\boxed{R}$ in the following way:

  (i) The condition under which the graphs intersect at two different points is $\boxed{N}$.

  (ii) The condition under which the graphs are tangent at a point is $\boxed{O}$.

  (iii) The condition under which the graph of $y=x^2+ax+a$ is always above the graph of $y=x+1$ is $\boxed{P}$.

  Choices: $⓪\ \boxed{Q}<a<\boxed{R}\qquad ①\ a=\boxed{Q}\ \text{or}\ a=\boxed{R}\qquad ②\ a<\boxed{Q}\ \text{or}\ \boxed{R}<a$

(2) Let us consider the case where $a$ satisfies $\boxed{P}$. Let $g(x)$ be the difference of the two functions, $g(x)=x^2+ax+a-(x+1)$, and let $m$ be the minimum value of $g(x)$. Then
$$m=-\dfrac{\boxed{S}}{\boxed{T}}\big(a^2-\boxed{U}\,a+\boxed{V}\big).$$
Hence $m$ takes the maximum at $a=\boxed{W}$ and its value there is $m=\boxed{X}$.

ja.prompt:
**[Ⅰ] 問2 — 二次関数** *（$\boxed{N},\boxed{O},\boxed{P}$ には $⓪$〜$②$ のうち正しい条件を選べ。）*

2つの関数 $y=x^2+ax+a$ と $y=x+1$ を考える。

(1) 2つの関数のグラフが交わる点の個数は，$a$ と数 $\boxed{Q}$，$\boxed{R}$ との関係によって次のように定まる。

  (i) 2つのグラフが異なる2点で交わる条件は $\boxed{N}$。

  (ii) 2つのグラフが1点で接する条件は $\boxed{O}$。

  (iii) $y=x^2+ax+a$ のグラフが常に $y=x+1$ のグラフより上にある条件は $\boxed{P}$。

  選択肢：$⓪\ \boxed{Q}<a<\boxed{R}\qquad ①\ a=\boxed{Q}\ \text{または}\ a=\boxed{R}\qquad ②\ a<\boxed{Q}\ \text{または}\ \boxed{R}<a$

(2) $a$ が $\boxed{P}$ を満たす場合を考える。$g(x)$ を2つの関数の差 $g(x)=x^2+ax+a-(x+1)$ とし，$m$ を $g(x)$ の最小値とすると，
$$m=-\dfrac{\boxed{S}}{\boxed{T}}\big(a^2-\boxed{U}\,a+\boxed{V}\big)。$$
よって $m$ は $a=\boxed{W}$ で最大となり，そのときの値は $m=\boxed{X}$ である。

answer.en: Discriminant $(a-1)(a-5)$, so $Q=1,R=5$: two points $⇒②$, tangent $⇒①$, always above $⇒⓪$. $g$ has minimum $m=-\tfrac14(a^2-6a+5)$, maximized at $a=3$ with $m=1$.  Boxes: N=2, O=1, P=0, QR=15, STUV=1465, W=3, X=1.
answer.ja: 判別式 $(a-1)(a-5)$ より $Q=1,R=5$。2点で交わる $⇒②$，接する $⇒①$，常に上 $⇒⓪$。$g$ の最小値 $m=-\tfrac14(a^2-6a+5)$ は $a=3$ で最大値 $1$。 解答：N=2, O=1, P=0, QR=15, STUV=1465, W=3, X=1。

explanation.en:
Set $x^2+ax+a=x+1\Rightarrow x^2+(a-1)x+(a-1)=0$. Discriminant $D=(a-1)^2-4(a-1)=(a-1)(a-5)$.
(i) Two intersections need $D>0\Rightarrow a<1$ or $5<a$ (choice ②, with $Q=1,R=5$).
(ii) Tangent needs $D=0\Rightarrow a=1$ or $a=5$ (choice ①).
(iii) The parabola lies strictly above the line everywhere $\Leftrightarrow D<0\Rightarrow 1<a<5$ (choice ⓪).
(2) $g(x)=x^2+(a-1)x+(a-1)$ has minimum $m=(a-1)-\dfrac{(a-1)^2}{4}=-\dfrac14\big(a^2-6a+5\big)$. This downward parabola in $a$ is maximized at $a=3$ (inside $1<a<5$), where $m=-\tfrac14(9-18+5)=1$.
explanation.ja: $x^2+ax+a=x+1$ より $x^2+(a-1)x+(a-1)=0$。判別式 $D=(a-1)^2-4(a-1)=(a-1)(a-5)$。(i) 異なる2点は $D>0\Rightarrow a<1$ または $5<a$（選択肢②，$Q=1,R=5$）。(ii) 接するのは $D=0\Rightarrow a=1,5$（選択肢①）。(iii) 常に上は $D<0\Rightarrow 1<a<5$（選択肢⓪）。(2) $g$ の最小値 $m=(a-1)-\dfrac{(a-1)^2}{4}=-\dfrac14(a^2-6a+5)$ は $a$ について上に凸で，$a=3$（区間内）で最大値 $m=1$。

questions.subtopic: Internal-division points on two segments by a common ratio; minimizing the distance between them

en.prompt:
**[II] Vectors.** Take four points $A(1,0),\ B(0,1),\ C(3,0),\ D(0,2)$ on a plane with the coordinate system having the origin $O$. Take two points $P$ and $Q$ on segments $AB$ and $CD$ respectively, such that $AP:PB=CQ:QD=k:2$. We are to find the minimum possible length of the segment $PQ$.

(1) First, let us find the value of $x+2y$, where $\overrightarrow{PQ}=(x,y)$. Since
$$\overrightarrow{OP}=\dfrac{\boxed{A}\,\overrightarrow{OA}+k\,\overrightarrow{OB}}{k+\boxed{B}},\qquad \overrightarrow{OQ}=\dfrac{\boxed{C}\,\overrightarrow{OC}+k\,\overrightarrow{OD}}{k+\boxed{D}},$$
we have $(x,y)=\dfrac{1}{k+\boxed{E}}\,(\boxed{F},\,k)$, which gives $x+2y=\boxed{G}$.

(2) When we represent $\mathrm{PQ}^2$ in terms of $y$, we have $\mathrm{PQ}^2=\boxed{H}\,y^2-\boxed{I}\,y+\boxed{J}$. Hence $\mathrm{PQ}$ takes the minimum at $y=\dfrac{\boxed{K}}{\boxed{L}}$ and its value there is $\mathrm{PQ}=\dfrac{\boxed{M}\sqrt{\boxed{N}}}{\boxed{O}}$. In this case, the value of $k$ is $k=\boxed{P}$.

ja.prompt:
**[Ⅱ] ベクトル** 原点 $O$ をもつ座標平面上に4点 $A(1,0),\ B(0,1),\ C(3,0),\ D(0,2)$ をとる。線分 $AB$ 上に点 $P$，線分 $CD$ 上に点 $Q$ を，$AP:PB=CQ:QD=k:2$ となるようにとる。線分 $PQ$ の長さの最小値を求める。

(1) まず $\overrightarrow{PQ}=(x,y)$ として $x+2y$ の値を求める。
$$\overrightarrow{OP}=\dfrac{\boxed{A}\,\overrightarrow{OA}+k\,\overrightarrow{OB}}{k+\boxed{B}},\qquad \overrightarrow{OQ}=\dfrac{\boxed{C}\,\overrightarrow{OC}+k\,\overrightarrow{OD}}{k+\boxed{D}}$$
であるから，$(x,y)=\dfrac{1}{k+\boxed{E}}\,(\boxed{F},\,k)$ となり，$x+2y=\boxed{G}$ である。

(2) $\mathrm{PQ}^2$ を $y$ で表すと $\mathrm{PQ}^2=\boxed{H}\,y^2-\boxed{I}\,y+\boxed{J}$。よって $\mathrm{PQ}$ は $y=\dfrac{\boxed{K}}{\boxed{L}}$ で最小となり，そのときの値は $\mathrm{PQ}=\dfrac{\boxed{M}\sqrt{\boxed{N}}}{\boxed{O}}$。このとき $k=\boxed{P}$ である。

answer.en: $\overrightarrow{OP}=\tfrac{2\overrightarrow{OA}+k\overrightarrow{OB}}{k+2}$, $\overrightarrow{OQ}=\tfrac{2\overrightarrow{OC}+k\overrightarrow{OD}}{k+2}$; $(x,y)=\tfrac{1}{k+2}(4,k)$, $x+2y=2$; $\mathrm{PQ}^2=5y^2-8y+4$ min at $y=\tfrac45$ giving $\mathrm{PQ}=\tfrac{2\sqrt5}{5}$, with $k=8$.  Boxes: AB=22, CD=22, EF=24, G=2, HIJ=584, KL=45, MNO=255, P=8.
answer.ja: $\overrightarrow{OP}=\tfrac{2\overrightarrow{OA}+k\overrightarrow{OB}}{k+2}$，$\overrightarrow{OQ}=\tfrac{2\overrightarrow{OC}+k\overrightarrow{OD}}{k+2}$；$(x,y)=\tfrac{1}{k+2}(4,k)$，$x+2y=2$；$\mathrm{PQ}^2=5y^2-8y+4$ は $y=\tfrac45$ で最小，$\mathrm{PQ}=\tfrac{2\sqrt5}{5}$，$k=8$。 解答：AB=22, CD=22, EF=24, G=2, HIJ=584, KL=45, MNO=255, P=8。

explanation.en:
Since $AP:PB=k:2$, $P$ divides $AB$ internally so $\overrightarrow{OP}=\dfrac{2\overrightarrow{OA}+k\overrightarrow{OB}}{k+2}$; likewise $\overrightarrow{OQ}=\dfrac{2\overrightarrow{OC}+k\overrightarrow{OD}}{k+2}$. With the given coordinates, $\overrightarrow{OP}=\big(\tfrac{2}{k+2},\tfrac{k}{k+2}\big)$ and $\overrightarrow{OQ}=\big(\tfrac{6}{k+2},\tfrac{2k}{k+2}\big)$, so $\overrightarrow{PQ}=\big(\tfrac{4}{k+2},\tfrac{k}{k+2}\big)=\dfrac{1}{k+2}(4,k)$. Then $x+2y=\dfrac{4+2k}{k+2}=2$.
(2) Using $y=\dfrac{k}{k+2}$ (so $0\le y<1$) and $x=2-2y$, $\mathrm{PQ}^2=x^2+y^2=(2-2y)^2+y^2=5y^2-8y+4$. This is minimized at $y=\dfrac{8}{10}=\dfrac45$, where $\mathrm{PQ}^2=\dfrac45$, so $\mathrm{PQ}=\sqrt{\tfrac45}=\dfrac{2\sqrt5}{5}$. From $y=\dfrac{k}{k+2}=\dfrac45$ we get $5k=4k+8\Rightarrow k=8$.
explanation.ja: $AP:PB=k:2$ より $P$ は内分点で $\overrightarrow{OP}=\dfrac{2\overrightarrow{OA}+k\overrightarrow{OB}}{k+2}$，同様に $\overrightarrow{OQ}=\dfrac{2\overrightarrow{OC}+k\overrightarrow{OD}}{k+2}$。座標を代入すると $\overrightarrow{OP}=\big(\tfrac{2}{k+2},\tfrac{k}{k+2}\big)$，$\overrightarrow{OQ}=\big(\tfrac{6}{k+2},\tfrac{2k}{k+2}\big)$ で，$\overrightarrow{PQ}=\dfrac{1}{k+2}(4,k)$。よって $x+2y=\dfrac{4+2k}{k+2}=2$。(2) $y=\dfrac{k}{k+2}$，$x=2-2y$ を用いると $\mathrm{PQ}^2=(2-2y)^2+y^2=5y^2-8y+4$。これは $y=\dfrac45$ で最小となり $\mathrm{PQ}^2=\dfrac45$，$\mathrm{PQ}=\dfrac{2\sqrt5}{5}$。$\dfrac{k}{k+2}=\dfrac45$ より $k=8$。

questions.subtopic: Two mutually tangent circles inscribed in a right triangle; half-angle/addition formulas and tangent lengths
questions.figureNote: Right triangle ABC with the right angle at B (B lower-left, C lower-right, A top). AB=9, BC=12, AC=15. A larger circle O1 (radius 2r) is tangent to sides AB and AC; a smaller circle O2 (radius r) is tangent to sides CA and CB; the two circles are externally tangent to each other. D and E are the points where AC touches O1 and O2 respectively (D nearer A, E nearer C).

en.prompt:
**[III] Figures and measurement.** *(See the figure.)* We have a triangle $ABC$ such that $AB=9,\ BC=12,\ \angle ABC=90^\circ$. There are also two circles $O_1$ and $O_2$ with radii of length $2r$ and $r$, respectively. The two circles $O_1$ and $O_2$ are tangential to each other. Further, $O_1$ is tangent to the two sides $AB$ and $AC$, and $O_2$ is tangent to the two sides $CA$ and $CB$. We are to find the value of $r$.

First, let $D$ and $E$ denote the points at which the segment $AC$ is tangent to the circles $O_1$ and $O_2$ respectively, and set $\alpha=\angle O_1AC$. Then, since $\tan 2\alpha=\dfrac{\boxed{A}}{\boxed{B}}$, we have $\tan\alpha=\dfrac{\boxed{C}}{\boxed{D}}$ using the double-angle formula. Thus we obtain $AD=\boxed{E}\,r$.

Next, set $\beta=\angle O_2CA$. Since $\alpha+\beta=\boxed{FG}^\circ$, we have $\tan\beta=\dfrac{\boxed{H}}{\boxed{I}}$ using the addition theorem. Thus we obtain $CE=\boxed{J}\,r$.

Moreover, it follows that $AC=\boxed{KL}$ and $DE=\boxed{M}\sqrt{\boxed{N}}\,r$. Finally we obtain
$$r=\dfrac{\boxed{OP}\big(\boxed{Q}-\boxed{R}\sqrt{\boxed{S}}\big)}{41}.$$

ja.prompt:
**[Ⅲ] 図形と計量** *（図を参照。）* $AB=9,\ BC=12,\ \angle ABC=90^\circ$ である三角形 $ABC$ がある。また，半径がそれぞれ $2r$，$r$ の2つの円 $O_1$，$O_2$ がある。2つの円 $O_1$，$O_2$ は互いに接している。さらに $O_1$ は2辺 $AB$，$AC$ に接し，$O_2$ は2辺 $CA$，$CB$ に接している。$r$ の値を求める。

まず，線分 $AC$ が円 $O_1$，$O_2$ に接する点をそれぞれ $D$，$E$ とし，$\alpha=\angle O_1AC$ とおく。このとき $\tan 2\alpha=\dfrac{\boxed{A}}{\boxed{B}}$ であるから，2倍角の公式より $\tan\alpha=\dfrac{\boxed{C}}{\boxed{D}}$ となる。よって $AD=\boxed{E}\,r$ を得る。

次に $\beta=\angle O_2CA$ とおく。$\alpha+\beta=\boxed{FG}^\circ$ であるから，加法定理より $\tan\beta=\dfrac{\boxed{H}}{\boxed{I}}$ となる。よって $CE=\boxed{J}\,r$ を得る。

さらに $AC=\boxed{KL}$，$DE=\boxed{M}\sqrt{\boxed{N}}\,r$ となる。最終的に
$$r=\dfrac{\boxed{OP}\big(\boxed{Q}-\boxed{R}\sqrt{\boxed{S}}\big)}{41}$$
を得る。

answer.en: $\tan 2\alpha=\tan A=\tfrac43\Rightarrow\tan\alpha=\tfrac12$, so $AD=4r$; $\alpha+\beta=45^\circ\Rightarrow\tan\beta=\tfrac13$, so $CE=3r$; $AC=15$, $DE=2\sqrt2\,r$, and $(7+2\sqrt2)r=15$ gives $r=\dfrac{15(7-2\sqrt2)}{41}$.  Boxes: AB=43, CD=12, E=4, FG=45, HI=13, J=3, KL=15, MN=22, OPQRS=15722.
answer.ja: $\tan 2\alpha=\tan A=\tfrac43\Rightarrow\tan\alpha=\tfrac12$ より $AD=4r$；$\alpha+\beta=45^\circ\Rightarrow\tan\beta=\tfrac13$ より $CE=3r$；$AC=15$，$DE=2\sqrt2\,r$，$(7+2\sqrt2)r=15$ より $r=\dfrac{15(7-2\sqrt2)}{41}$。 解答：AB=43, CD=12, E=4, FG=45, HI=13, J=3, KL=15, MN=22, OPQRS=15722。

explanation.en:
In right triangle $ABC$ ($\angle B=90^\circ$), $\tan A=\dfrac{BC}{AB}=\dfrac{12}{9}=\dfrac43$. Since $O_1$ lies on the bisector of $\angle A$, $2\alpha=A$, so $\tan 2\alpha=\tfrac43$; the double-angle formula $\tfrac{2\tan\alpha}{1-\tan^2\alpha}=\tfrac43$ gives $2\tan^2\alpha+3\tan\alpha-2=0\Rightarrow\tan\alpha=\tfrac12$. The tangent length from $A$ to $O_1$ is $AD$, with $\tan\alpha=\dfrac{O_1D}{AD}=\dfrac{2r}{AD}\Rightarrow AD=\dfrac{2r}{1/2}=4r$.
Because $\angle A+\angle C=90^\circ$ and $2\alpha=A,\ 2\beta=C$, we get $\alpha+\beta=45^\circ$. Then $\tan(\alpha+\beta)=1=\dfrac{\tan\alpha+\tan\beta}{1-\tan\alpha\tan\beta}$ with $\tan\alpha=\tfrac12$ gives $\tan\beta=\tfrac13$. The tangent length $CE=\dfrac{r}{\tan\beta}=\dfrac{r}{1/3}=3r$.
With $AC=\sqrt{9^2+12^2}=15$, the gap $DE$ between the two tangency points equals $\sqrt{(O_1O_2)^2-(2r-r)^2}=\sqrt{(3r)^2-r^2}=2\sqrt2\,r$ (the circles are externally tangent, $O_1O_2=3r$). Then $AD+DE+EC=AC$: $4r+2\sqrt2\,r+3r=15\Rightarrow(7+2\sqrt2)r=15\Rightarrow r=\dfrac{15}{7+2\sqrt2}=\dfrac{15(7-2\sqrt2)}{49-8}=\dfrac{15(7-2\sqrt2)}{41}$.
explanation.ja: 直角三角形 $ABC$（$\angle B=90^\circ$）で $\tan A=\dfrac{BC}{AB}=\dfrac{12}{9}=\dfrac43$。$O_1$ は $\angle A$ の二等分線上にあるので $2\alpha=A$，よって $\tan 2\alpha=\tfrac43$。2倍角 $\dfrac{2\tan\alpha}{1-\tan^2\alpha}=\tfrac43$ より $2\tan^2\alpha+3\tan\alpha-2=0\Rightarrow\tan\alpha=\tfrac12$。接線長 $AD$ は $\tan\alpha=\dfrac{2r}{AD}$ より $AD=4r$。$\angle A+\angle C=90^\circ$ かつ $2\alpha=A,2\beta=C$ なので $\alpha+\beta=45^\circ$。加法定理 $1=\dfrac{\tan\alpha+\tan\beta}{1-\tan\alpha\tan\beta}$ より $\tan\beta=\tfrac13$，接線長 $CE=\dfrac{r}{1/3}=3r$。$AC=\sqrt{9^2+12^2}=15$，接点間の距離 $DE=\sqrt{(3r)^2-r^2}=2\sqrt2\,r$（外接で $O_1O_2=3r$）。$4r+2\sqrt2\,r+3r=15$ より $(7+2\sqrt2)r=15$，$r=\dfrac{15}{7+2\sqrt2}=\dfrac{15(7-2\sqrt2)}{41}$。

questions.subtopic: Zeros of an exponential-trigonometric function, antiderivative by undetermined coefficients, and a definite integral

en.prompt:
**[IV] Q1 — Calculus.** Let $f(x)=4\sqrt3\,e^{-x}\cos x+6e^{-x}$.

(1) Let $a$ and $b$ $(a<b)$ be the values of $x$ satisfying $f(x)=0$ on $0\le x<2\pi$. Then $a=\dfrac{\boxed{A}}{\boxed{B}}\pi,\quad b=\dfrac{\boxed{C}}{\boxed{D}}\pi$.

(2) The values of the constants $p$ and $q$ satisfying
$$\dfrac{d}{dx}\big(p\,e^{-x}\cos x+q\,e^{-x}\sin x\big)=e^{-x}\cos x$$
are given by $p=\dfrac{\boxed{EF}}{\boxed{G}},\quad q=\dfrac{\boxed{H}}{\boxed{I}}$.

(3) Using the values of $a$ and $b$ obtained in (1), we set $A=e^{-a}$ and $B=e^{-b}$. When we calculate the value of $\displaystyle\int_a^b f(x)\,dx$, we obtain
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=\big(\boxed{J}-\sqrt{\boxed{K}}\big)A-\big(\boxed{L}+\sqrt{\boxed{M}}\big)B.$$

ja.prompt:
**[Ⅳ] 問1 — 微分積分** $f(x)=4\sqrt3\,e^{-x}\cos x+6e^{-x}$ とする。

(1) $0\le x<2\pi$ で $f(x)=0$ を満たす $x$ の値を $a,b\ (a<b)$ とすると，$a=\dfrac{\boxed{A}}{\boxed{B}}\pi,\quad b=\dfrac{\boxed{C}}{\boxed{D}}\pi$ である。

(2) 等式
$$\dfrac{d}{dx}\big(p\,e^{-x}\cos x+q\,e^{-x}\sin x\big)=e^{-x}\cos x$$
を満たす定数 $p,q$ は $p=\dfrac{\boxed{EF}}{\boxed{G}},\quad q=\dfrac{\boxed{H}}{\boxed{I}}$ で与えられる。

(3) (1) で求めた $a,b$ を用いて $A=e^{-a}$，$B=e^{-b}$ とおく。$\displaystyle\int_a^b f(x)\,dx$ を計算すると，
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=\big(\boxed{J}-\sqrt{\boxed{K}}\big)A-\big(\boxed{L}+\sqrt{\boxed{M}}\big)B$$
となる。

answer.en: $f=0\Rightarrow\cos x=-\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$, so $a=\tfrac56\pi,\ b=\tfrac76\pi$; $p=-\tfrac12,\ q=\tfrac12$; $\int_a^b f\,dx=(3-\sqrt3)A-(3+\sqrt3)B$.  Boxes: AB=56, CD=76, EFG=-12, HI=12, JK=33, LM=33.
answer.ja: $f=0\Rightarrow\cos x=-\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$ より $a=\tfrac56\pi,\ b=\tfrac76\pi$；$p=-\tfrac12,\ q=\tfrac12$；$\int_a^b f\,dx=(3-\sqrt3)A-(3+\sqrt3)B$。 解答：AB=56, CD=76, EFG=-12, HI=12, JK=33, LM=33。

explanation.en:
(1) Since $e^{-x}>0$, $f(x)=0\Leftrightarrow 4\sqrt3\cos x+6=0\Leftrightarrow\cos x=-\dfrac{6}{4\sqrt3}=-\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$. On $0\le x<2\pi$ this gives $x=\dfrac56\pi$ and $\dfrac76\pi$, so $a=\tfrac56\pi,\ b=\tfrac76\pi$.
(2) $\dfrac{d}{dx}\big(pe^{-x}\cos x+qe^{-x}\sin x\big)=e^{-x}\big[(-p+q)\cos x+(-p-q)\sin x\big]$. Matching $e^{-x}\cos x$ requires $-p+q=1$ and $-p-q=0$, so $p=-\tfrac12,\ q=\tfrac12$.
(3) An antiderivative of $e^{-x}\cos x$ is $-\tfrac12 e^{-x}\cos x+\tfrac12 e^{-x}\sin x$, so $\int 4\sqrt3 e^{-x}\cos x\,dx=2\sqrt3 e^{-x}(\sin x-\cos x)$ and $\int 6e^{-x}\,dx=-6e^{-x}$. Hence $F(x)=2\sqrt3 e^{-x}(\sin x-\cos x)-6e^{-x}$. At $x=a=\tfrac56\pi$: $\sin=\tfrac12,\cos=-\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$; at $x=b=\tfrac76\pi$: $\sin=-\tfrac12,\cos=-\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$. Then $F(b)-F(a)=(3-\sqrt3)e^{-a}-(3+\sqrt3)e^{-b}=(3-\sqrt3)A-(3+\sqrt3)B$.
explanation.ja: (1) $e^{-x}>0$ なので $f(x)=0\Leftrightarrow 4\sqrt3\cos x+6=0\Leftrightarrow\cos x=-\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$。$0\le x<2\pi$ で $x=\tfrac56\pi,\tfrac76\pi$ なので $a=\tfrac56\pi,b=\tfrac76\pi$。(2) 微分すると $e^{-x}\big[(-p+q)\cos x+(-p-q)\sin x\big]$。$e^{-x}\cos x$ に一致するには $-p+q=1,\ -p-q=0$，よって $p=-\tfrac12,q=\tfrac12$。(3) $e^{-x}\cos x$ の原始関数は $-\tfrac12 e^{-x}\cos x+\tfrac12 e^{-x}\sin x$ なので $F(x)=2\sqrt3 e^{-x}(\sin x-\cos x)-6e^{-x}$。$x=\tfrac56\pi$ で $\sin=\tfrac12,\cos=-\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$，$x=\tfrac76\pi$ で $\sin=-\tfrac12,\cos=-\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$。よって $F(b)-F(a)=(3-\sqrt3)A-(3+\sqrt3)B$。

en.prompt:
**[IV] Q2 — Integration.** *(For $\boxed{S}$ and $\boxed{T}$, choose the appropriate expression from the choices $⓪$–$⑨$ below.)*

Consider the definite integral $S=\displaystyle\int_0^a x\sqrt{\tfrac13 x+2}\,dx$.

(1) Set $t=\sqrt{\tfrac13 x+2}$. Then we have
$$\int x\sqrt{\tfrac13 x+2}\,dx=\boxed{NO}\int\big(t^{\boxed{P}}-\boxed{Q}\,t^{\boxed{R}}\big)\,dt=\boxed{S}+C,$$
where $C$ is the integral constant.

(2) Using the result in (1), we have $S=\boxed{T}$. Thus we obtain $\displaystyle\lim_{a\to\infty}\dfrac{S}{a^{\boxed{U}/\boxed{V}}}=\dfrac{\boxed{W}\sqrt{\boxed{X}}}{\boxed{YZ}}$.

Choices: $⓪\ \tfrac65 t^5(3t^2-10)\quad ①\ \tfrac65 t^3(3t^2-10)\quad ②\ \tfrac{12}{5} t^5(3t^2-5)\quad ③\ \tfrac{12}{5} t^3(3t^2-5)\quad ④\ \tfrac65 t^3(3t^2-5)\quad ⑤\ \tfrac65\big\{\big(\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2}\big)^5(a-4)+8\sqrt2\big\}\quad ⑥\ \tfrac{12}{5}\big\{\big(\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2}\big)^3(a-2)+4\sqrt2\big\}\quad ⑦\ \tfrac65\big\{\big(\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2}\big)^5(a-2)+4\sqrt2\big\}\quad ⑧\ \tfrac65\big\{\big(\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2}\big)^3(a-4)+8\sqrt2\big\}\quad ⑨\ \tfrac65\big\{\big(\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2}\big)^3(a-2)+8\sqrt2\big\}$

ja.prompt:
**[Ⅳ] 問2 — 積分** *（$\boxed{S}$，$\boxed{T}$ には下の選択肢 $⓪$〜$⑨$ から適切な式を選べ。）*

定積分 $S=\displaystyle\int_0^a x\sqrt{\tfrac13 x+2}\,dx$ を考える。

(1) $t=\sqrt{\tfrac13 x+2}$ とおくと，
$$\int x\sqrt{\tfrac13 x+2}\,dx=\boxed{NO}\int\big(t^{\boxed{P}}-\boxed{Q}\,t^{\boxed{R}}\big)\,dt=\boxed{S}+C$$
となる（$C$ は積分定数）。

(2) (1) の結果を用いると $S=\boxed{T}$。よって $\displaystyle\lim_{a\to\infty}\dfrac{S}{a^{\boxed{U}/\boxed{V}}}=\dfrac{\boxed{W}\sqrt{\boxed{X}}}{\boxed{YZ}}$ となる。

選択肢：$⓪\ \tfrac65 t^5(3t^2-10)\quad ①\ \tfrac65 t^3(3t^2-10)\quad ②\ \tfrac{12}{5} t^5(3t^2-5)\quad ③\ \tfrac{12}{5} t^3(3t^2-5)\quad ④\ \tfrac65 t^3(3t^2-5)\quad ⑤\ \tfrac65\big\{\big(\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2}\big)^5(a-4)+8\sqrt2\big\}\quad ⑥\ \tfrac{12}{5}\big\{\big(\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2}\big)^3(a-2)+4\sqrt2\big\}\quad ⑦\ \tfrac65\big\{\big(\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2}\big)^5(a-2)+4\sqrt2\big\}\quad ⑧\ \tfrac65\big\{\big(\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2}\big)^3(a-4)+8\sqrt2\big\}\quad ⑨\ \tfrac65\big\{\big(\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2}\big)^3(a-2)+8\sqrt2\big\}$

answer.en: With $t=\sqrt{\tfrac13 x+2}$, $x=3t^2-6,\ dx=6t\,dt$, integrand $=18(t^4-2t^2)$; antiderivative $=\tfrac65 t^3(3t^2-10)$ (choice ①). $S=\tfrac65\{(\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2})^3(a-4)+8\sqrt2\}$ (choice ⑧). $\displaystyle\lim_{a\to\infty}\dfrac{S}{a^{5/2}}=\dfrac{2\sqrt3}{15}$.  Boxes: NOPQR=18422, S=1, T=8, UV=52, WXYZ=2315.
answer.ja: $t=\sqrt{\tfrac13 x+2}$ で $x=3t^2-6,\ dx=6t\,dt$，被積分関数 $=18(t^4-2t^2)$；原始関数 $=\tfrac65 t^3(3t^2-10)$（選択肢①）。$S=\tfrac65\{(\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2})^3(a-4)+8\sqrt2\}$（選択肢⑧）。$\displaystyle\lim_{a\to\infty}\dfrac{S}{a^{5/2}}=\dfrac{2\sqrt3}{15}$。 解答：NOPQR=18422, S=1, T=8, UV=52, WXYZ=2315。

explanation.en:
(1) Put $t=\sqrt{\tfrac13 x+2}$, so $t^2=\tfrac13 x+2$, $x=3t^2-6$ and $dx=6t\,dt$. Then $x\sqrt{\tfrac13 x+2}\,dx=(3t^2-6)\,t\,(6t\,dt)=18(t^4-2t^2)\,dt$, so $\boxed{NO}=18,\boxed{P}=4,\boxed{Q}=2,\boxed{R}=2$. Integrating, $18\int(t^4-2t^2)\,dt=\tfrac{18}{5}t^5-12t^3=\tfrac65 t^3(3t^2-10)$, which is choice ①.
(2) The limits become $x=0\Rightarrow t=\sqrt2$ and $x=a\Rightarrow t=\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2}$. Evaluating, $S=\Big[\tfrac65 t^3(3t^2-10)\Big]_{\sqrt2}^{\sqrt{a/3+2}}=\tfrac65\Big\{\big(\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2}\big)^3(a-4)+8\sqrt2\Big\}$ (using $3t^2-10=a-4$ at the upper limit and $-\tfrac65(\sqrt2)^3(6-10)=\tfrac65\cdot8\sqrt2$ at the lower), which is choice ⑧. As $a\to\infty$, the leading term is $\tfrac65\cdot a^{3/2}\cdot a=\tfrac65 a^{5/2}$... more precisely $S\sim\tfrac{2\sqrt3}{15}a^{5/2}$, so $\displaystyle\lim_{a\to\infty}\dfrac{S}{a^{5/2}}=\dfrac{2\sqrt3}{15}$.
explanation.ja: (1) $t=\sqrt{\tfrac13 x+2}$ とおくと $t^2=\tfrac13 x+2$，$x=3t^2-6$，$dx=6t\,dt$。よって $x\sqrt{\tfrac13 x+2}\,dx=(3t^2-6)t(6t\,dt)=18(t^4-2t^2)\,dt$ なので $\boxed{NO}=18,P=4,Q=2,R=2$。積分して $18\int(t^4-2t^2)dt=\tfrac{18}{5}t^5-12t^3=\tfrac65 t^3(3t^2-10)$（選択肢①）。(2) 積分区間は $x=0\Rightarrow t=\sqrt2$，$x=a\Rightarrow t=\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2}$。計算すると $S=\tfrac65\{(\sqrt{\tfrac13 a+2})^3(a-4)+8\sqrt2\}$（選択肢⑧）。$a\to\infty$ で主要項は $\tfrac{2\sqrt3}{15}a^{5/2}$ なので $\displaystyle\lim_{a\to\infty}\dfrac{S}{a^{5/2}}=\dfrac{2\sqrt3}{15}$。
